intro.sr: Administrator kreira novi paket sesija - bira postojeću uslugu, unosi cenu i obavezno postavlja sliku, sve pre nego što paket bude spreman za dodelu klijentima.
intro.en: The admin creates a new session package - selecting an existing service, entering a price, and setting a required image, all before the package is ready to be assigned to customers.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs into their account.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator na telefonu otvara glavni meni dugmetom sa tri crtice.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: On a phone the admin opens the main menu with the three-line button.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: In the “Admin” section they tap “Admin panel”.

admin-paketi-otvara-meni.sr: Admin panel ima sopstveni meni iza dugmeta sa tri crtice. Otvaramo ga i biramo grupu „Katalog“.
admin-paketi-otvara-meni.en: The admin panel has its own menu behind a three-line button. We open it and choose the “Katalog” group.

admin-paketi-bira-stavku.en: The admin taps "Packages" in the menu.

unos-osnovnih-podataka.sr: Administrator unosi naziv i opis paketa.
unos-osnovnih-podataka.en: The admin enters the package's name and description.

heading.en: Add a service to the package

dodavanje-usluge-u-paket.sr: Administrator dodaje red, bira tačno određenu uslugu i varijantu, i unosi broj seansi koje paket sadrži.
dodavanje-usluge-u-paket.en: The admin adds a row, picks the exact service and variant, and enters how many sessions the package includes.

unos-cene.sr: Administrator unosi cenu celog paketa - obično nižu od zbira pojedinačnih seansi.
unos-cene.en: The admin enters the package's total price - usually lower than the sum of individual sessions.

otpremanje-slike.sr: Slika je obavezna za paket - administrator je otprema i unosi alt tekst.
otpremanje-slike.en: An image is required for a package - the admin uploads one and enters alt text.

cuvanje-paketa.sr: Administrator čuva paket - sada je spreman da se dodeli klijentima.
cuvanje-paketa.en: The admin saves the package - it's now ready to be assigned to customers.
